question:
**Direction: Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

Largest farmers usually have more money, social power and local influence.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"Largest farmers usually."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'largest'** should be replaced with** 'wealthiest' **or **'most prosperous.'**
 
• And before superlative degree we usually use definite article **'The'.**
 
• **'Largest'** refers to physical size, not financial status. (**'Largest'** भौतिक आकार को दर्शाता है, वित्तीय स्थिति को नहीं।)
 
 
• **Example**: *This is the **largest**__ building in the town.*
 
 
 
• **​"Wealthiest" **means having a lot of money, property, etc. (धनी, अमीर, संपन्‍न)
 __
 
• **Example**: *He is the **wealthiest**__ man.*
 
 
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: ***__The Wealthiest__** farmers usually have more money, social power and local influence.*
